gloss: express bus; highway bus; long-distance bus

definitions.gloss: express bus; highway bus; long-distance bus
definitions.explanation: A bus that travels on expressways, connecting cities or distant areas. A common and affordable alternative to trains for intercity travel in Japan.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}バス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to Osaka by express bus.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}バス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The express bus is cheaper than the bullet train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜行|やこう}→夜行：04078_yakou⟧{高速|こうそく}バス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}れば→乗る：00511_noru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you take an overnight express bus, you'll arrive at your destination by morning.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧ (high speed; expressway) + ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ (bus). Refers to buses that travel on expressways (⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧) for intercity transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高速|こうそく}バス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride an express bus
- {高速|こうそく}バス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book an express bus
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}→夜行：04078_yakou⟧{高速|こうそく}バス: overnight express bus
- {高速|こうそく}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗|の}り{場|ば}→乗り場：01041_noriba⟧: express bus stop/terminal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}バス→路線バス：20398_rosenbasu⟧: local route bus — operates within a city
- ⟦{貸切|かしきり}バス→貸切バス：22719_kashikiribasu⟧: chartered bus — rented for group travel
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}バス→夜行バス：22452_yakoubasu⟧: overnight bus — a subcategory of {高速|こうそく}バス

CULTURAL NOTE:
Express buses are a budget-friendly way to travel between Japanese cities. Popular routes include Tokyo-Osaka and Tokyo-Nagoya. Overnight buses (⟦{夜行|やこう}バス→夜行バス：22452_yakoubasu⟧) are especially popular among students and budget travelers, as they save on hotel costs.
